title: The 99% one-day VaR as a tail
caption: Daily losses on the £10m portfolio are normal with standard deviation £100,000. The 1% worst outcomes lie beyond 2.326 standard deviations, £232,600, which is the 99% VaR.
alt: A bell curve of daily loss in £ thousands, with the 1% tail beyond £232.6k shaded.
description: The 99th percentile of a normal is z = 2.326.
VaR = 2.326 × £100,000 ≈ £232,600: only 1% of days should lose more.
